ideas.children_he: הַמְשׁוֹרֵר פּוֹנֶה לַה׳ וּמְבַקֵּשׁ שֶׁיִּשְׁמַע אֶת תְּפִלָּתוֹ.
ideas.children_en: The psalmist turns to God and asks Him to hear his prayer.

ideas.children_he: מִתּוֹךְ חֻלְשָׁה וְרִחוּק, הוּא מְבַקֵּשׁ הַדְרָכָה וּמַחֲסֶה וּמוֹדֶה עַל עֶזְרַת ה׳.
ideas.children_en: From weakness and distance, he asks for guidance and shelter and thanks God for His help.

ideas.children_he: הוּא מְבַקֵּשׁ חַיִּים וְהַגָּנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ וּמַבְטִיחַ לְקַיֵּם אֶת נְדָרָיו יוֹם יוֹם.
ideas.children_en: He asks for the king's life and protection and promises to keep his vows daily.
